dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Well, that was an interesting poem.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hehe... I am your teacher, after all. It wouldn't be much good if my mind couldn't keep up with my students'.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: But you should understand it however it makes sense to you. My little wolf cub will improve much more quickly that way.
